app.description: Search Mikan and update subscriptions from a cleaner web UI.
app.tagline: Mikan RSS console for subscriptions and downloads.
auth.subtitle: Use the server credentials from your local environment.
common.title: Title
downloads.emptyBoardText: Refresh RSS or pick a subscription to inspect scoped activity.
downloads.emptyMoveJobs: No files are being moved right now.
downloads.emptySeeding: No qB seeding episodes right now.
downloads.libraryAgentClaimed: The library agent has claimed this episode.
downloads.movedAndUntracked: Moved and no longer tracked by qB
downloads.transferFailure: The agent reported a transfer failure.
downloads.waitingForAgent: Waiting for a library agent to claim it.
downloads.notes.views.label: Views
downloads.notes.views.text: Sections are independent; one episode can appear in Seeding and Move Jobs at the same time.
downloads.notes.attention.label: Needs Attention
downloads.notes.attention.text: qB read errors, missing qB torrents, or failed move jobs. Retry move appears here after a move failure.
downloads.notes.active.label: Active Queue
downloads.notes.active.text: qB torrents that are still downloading or checking.
downloads.notes.moveJobs.label: Move Jobs
downloads.notes.moveJobs.text: Files currently claimed by the library agent and being copied into the library.
downloads.notes.seeding.label: Seeding
downloads.notes.seeding.text: Completed qB torrents that are still present in qB, including files already moved but still sharing.
downloads.notes.history.label: Moved History
downloads.notes.history.text: Files copied into the library. They may also remain in Seeding until qB reaches the share limit.
downloads.notes.cleaned.label: Cleaned
downloads.notes.cleaned.text: Moved first, then removed from qBittorrent and its download storage after ratio or time limits stop it.
downloads.notes.notFound.label: Not found
downloads.notes.notFound.text: Tracked locally, but qB currently has no matching torrent.
downloads.notes.qbUnavailable.label: qB unavailable
downloads.notes.qbUnavailable.text: The server could not read qB status during this refresh.
